subject: Session room update
text:
The club's monthly meeting will move to the smaller room this time, not the main hall. I know that is not what you expected, and I understand your preference for the larger space.

We still have the same agenda, the same arrival time, and the same contact person if directions are unclear. I hope this adjustment does not cause difficulty. If you would like to discuss it before arriving, please say so, and we can look at a workable compromise.
